name: The Kindly Rest
descriptionSeed: A house of healing on the valley's south shoulder, kept by an order that has never named itself and has no argument with anyone. They take in whoever arrives and ask nothing, and they are careful about what they are owed. The herb work is the whole economy of the place — the terraces are planted to it, the drying lofts run the length of the roof, and what they cannot grow they trade for at cost. The intrigue here is the quiet kind: who is being sheltered, who is asking after them, and which of those questions the house answers.
appearance: Low buildings of pale stone around three sides of a planted court, roofed in weathered shingle with deep eaves. Drying lofts stand open under the roofline, hung with cut herbs in bunches. Terraced beds step down the slope in stone-edged rows, a covered walk runs the inner faces, and water is led through the court in an open stone channel. The doors stand open and there is no gate.
encounterFlavor: Someone is always arriving and someone is always leaving, and the house does not comment on either. A bell is rung for meals and for nothing else.

questSeeds: Sister Vreni is short-handed and will take on anyone who can actually treat a wound — the work is real, and it is how the house decides whether it trusts you
Somebody is being sheltered here under a name that is not theirs, and two separate parties have come asking after them politely
The high terraces have stopped yielding the one herb the house cannot trade for, and nobody can say why
